says: In our tooling, .agents/skills/lead/scripts/flow/machine.ts calls Machine.make with no flow/machine.laws.test.ts beside it holding a property law and a sync test or a reason, so fabrika/machine-has-laws, on for next/ only, cannot join the .agents/ mirror block (0033) at zero.
proof: oxlint with only fabrika/machine-has-laws on (a config whose jsPlugins is oxlint-plugins/index.ts and whose rules hold only that rule), run as `pnpm exec oxlint -c <that config> next .agents`, printed one error and nothing for next/: `.agents/skills/lead/scripts/flow/machine.ts:99:10: error fabrika(machine-has-laws): Every machine has laws (docs/direction/every-machine-has-laws.md). Add machine.laws.test.ts beside this file, with a property law on the machine's real init and update (it.prop, it.effect.prop, fc.assert or tea's pbt).` The folder holds only machine.ts and machine.test.ts.
cost: The .agents/ block of .oxlintrc.json stops being next/'s twin for this rule, and the flow machine that drives every quest has no sync test, so a save and load fault in it is found only on a live quest.
